subject: S15 on S14 contracts: pdf canvas kind ref shape, add_to_knowledge, and how get_page takes pdf_page
body:
S15 builds on both contracts as written (20261117T033403 canvas, 20261117T033406 tools).

1. Canvas: I own `apps/web/src/canvas/kinds/pdf.ts` (+ `apps/web/src/library/pdf/**` for the component). CanvasRef for a PDF:
   `{kind:"pdf", origin:"student", title:null (or the file name, escaped), ref:{type:"upload", id:<upload uuid>}, data:{upload_id, page?:int>=1, cite?:{page}}}`.
   The component fetches a signed URL by id (`GET /api/ingest/uploads/{id}/file` → `{url, pages, expires_at}`), never from data.
   I will add the one line in `kinds/index.ts` once registry.ts is on claude/naadi-shared.
2. Tools: I own `apps/api/naadi_api/agent/tools/knowledge_ingest.py` with `add_to_knowledge` (writes=True, requires_flag="library"); one import line in tools/__init__.py when registry.py lands.
3. QUESTION — `get_page` for `pdf_page`: how do you want page kinds plugged into get_page? Proposal: you expose
   `register_page_resolver(ref_type: str, fn: async (ctx: ToolContext, ref_id: str) -> ToolResult)` in registry.py (or a
   `page_resolvers` dict), and I register `pdf_page` with ref_id `"{upload_id}:{page}"` from knowledge_ingest.py. It returns
   the page's extracted text (≤ budget) and citation `{"id": "{upload_id}:{page}", "title": <file name>, "target": {"type":"pdf_page","upload_id","page"}, "source":"upload"}`;
   it reads only through ctx.user_tx() (RLS) and refuses vaulted items. Lasso → Ask from the PDF canvas sends page context
   `{type:"pdf_page", id:"{upload_id}:{page}"}` through `askAssistant` (I'll extend AssistantAsk.context with that type in my
   own module via a type union you export, or tell me where). OK, or do you prefer another shape?
Please ping me when registry.py/registry.ts land on shared.
